English: A review was conducted of all confirmed rabies cases in South Africa from 1993 to 2019, with a total of 11 701 cases identified to species level to assess the wildlife plays in the epidemiology of rabies.

Yoruba: Agbéyẹ̀wò wáyé fún gbogbo àwọn kéèsì rébéèsì ní South Africa láti ọdún 1993 sí 2019, bẹ́ẹ̀ ni a se àkíyèsí pé iye kéèsì ọgánísíìmù 11 701 ni wọ́n ń wọ agbo ẹranko ìgbẹ́ tí wọ́n sì ń ṣe okùnfà àjàkálẹ̀ àrùn rébíìsì.
Zulu: Kwenziwa ukubuyekezwa kwazo zonke izigameko eziqinisekisiwe zamarabi eNingizimu Afrika kusukela ngo-1993 kuya ku-2019, kanti zingu-11 701 izigameko ezihlonzwe ngokwezinga lezinhlobo zezilwane ukuze kuhlolwe imidlalo yezilwane zasendle kubhubhane lwamarabi.
Hausa: An gudanar da bita a kan dukkan waɗanda aka tabbatar sun kamu da ciwon hauka a Afirka ta Kudu daga shekarar 1993 zuwa shekarar 2019, inda aka gano adadin mutane 11 701 zuwa matakin jinsi don tantance rawar namun dajin a ilimin cututtuka masu yaɗuwa na ciwon hauka.
Northern Sotho: Tekodišišo e dirilwe ya bogaswi bja dimpša ka moka ao a tiišeditšwego ka Afrika Borwa go tloga ka 1993 go fihla ka 2019, fao go hlathilwego palomoka ya malwetši a 11 701 mabapi le mehuta ya diphedi go sekaseka tema ye e ralokwago ke diphoofolo tša lešoka ka thutatwetšing ya bogaswi bja dimpša.
Amharic: በደቡብ አፍሪካ ከ1993 እስከ 2019 ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ በሁሉም የተረጋገጡ የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ ጉዳዮች ላይ ግምገማ ተካሂዶ ነበር፣ በጠቅላላው 11 701 በእብድ ውሻ በሽታ ኢፒዲሞሎጂ የዱር አራዊት ሚናን ለመገምገም እስከ ዝርያዎች ድረስ ተለይተዋል።

English: A spatiotemporal cluster analysis using a discrete Poisson space-time probability model, accounting for underlying estimated dog and livestock densities, identified 13 significant clusters (p<0.05).
Luganda: Enneekalirizakiseera ey’ekibinja wakati mu kukozesa omutetenkanyirizo gwa Poisson ogw’okuteebereza, ogufa ku bungi bw’embwa n’ensolo ezirundibwa, gwazuula ebibinja 13 eby’enkizo (p<0.05).
Yoruba: Àtúpalẹ̀ lórí ọwọ́já ìtànkalẹ̀ àrun tí ó ṣe àmúlò tíọ́rí Poisson, èyí tí ó dá lórí ìlànà ààyè òun àkókò, èyí tí ó ń ṣe ìṣirò fún iye ajá àti ohun ọ̀sìn, tí ó sì ṣe àfihàn àwọn agbo 13 tí ó ṣe pàtàkì (p<0.05).
Zulu: Ukuhlaziywa kweqoqo le-spatiotemporal kusetshenziswa imodeli yamathuba esikhathi sesikhathi se-Poisson eqondile, ukubalwa kokuminyana okucatshangelwayo kwezinja nemfuyo, kuhlonze amaqoqo abalulekile angu-13 (p<0.05).
Hausa: Binciken gungu na sarari da lokaci ta amfani da ɗaiɗaikun Poisson samfurin yiwuwar lokacin sarari, da ɓoyayyun dalilai na yawan karnuka da dabbobin gida, an gano manyan gungu 13 (p<0.05).
Northern Sotho: Tshekatsheko ya nakowana ya sehlopha sa lefelong ka go šomiša mokgwa wa kgonagalo ya sekgoba le nako wa Poisson, go akaretšwa malwetši ao a sa bonagalego a dimpša le a diruiwa, e utollotše dihlopha tše 13 tše bohlokwa (p<0.05).

English: Yellow mongoose (Cynictis penicillate) was the most frequently affected wildlife species, followed by bat-eared fox (Otocyon megalotis), black-backed jackal (Canis mesomelas), meerkat (Suricata suricatta) and aardwolf (Proteles cristatus).

Zulu: I-mongoose ephuzi (i-Cynictis penicillate) kwakuyizinhlobo zezilwane zasendle ezithinteka kakhulu, kulandelwa impungushe enamadlebe (i-Otocyon megalotis), impungushe enomqolo omnyama (Canis mesomelas), i-meerkat (Suricata suricatta), kanye ne-aardwolf (Proteles cristatus).

English: In this study, researchers wanted to map exactly how domestic and wild animals are spreading rabies in the country.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza kuno, abanoonyereza baayagala okuzuulira ddala engeri ensolo z’ewaka z’ensolo z’omu nsiko gye zisaasaanyaamu endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo mu ggwanga.
Yoruba: Nínú iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí, àwọn olùwádìí fẹ́ láti ṣe òdiwọ̀n ní pàtó bí àwọn ẹranko ilé àti ẹranko igbó ṣe ń ṣe okùnfa ìrànkiri àrùn rébíísì ní orílẹ̀ èdè náà.
Zulu: Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuveza kahle ukuthi izilwane ezifuywayo nezisendle ziwasakaza kanjani amarabi ezweni.
Hausa: A wannan binciken, masu binciken sun so su yi taswirar daidai yadda dabbobin gida da na daji suke yaɗa cutar ciwon haukar a ƙasar.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo dinyakišišong tše, banyakišiši ba nyakile go beakanya gabotse ka fao diphoofolo tša ka gae le diphooflo tša naga di phatlalatšago bogaswi bja diphoofolo ka mo nageng.
Amharic: በዚህ ጥናት፣ ተመራማሪዎች የቤት እና የዱር አራዊት በሀገሪቱ ውስጥ የእብድ ውሻ በሽታን እንዴት እንደሚያሰራጩ በትክክል ለመንደፍ ፈልገዋል።

English: They reviewed 11 701 rabies cases stored in a national database between 1993 and 2019.
Luganda: Beekaliriza obubaka 11,701 obw’endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo obwaterekebwa mu tterekero ly’eggwanga wakati wa 1993 ne 2019.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò kéèsì rébíìsì 11 701, èyí tí wọ́n wà ní ìpamọ́ national database láàárín ọdún 1993 àti 2019.
Zulu: Babuyekeze 11 701 amacala amarabi agcinwe kusizindalwazi sikazwelonke phakathi kuka-1993 no-2019.
Hausa: Sun yi bita a kan aukuwar ciwon hauka guda 11 701 da aka adana a cikin rumbun bayanan ƙasa a tsakanin shekarar 1993 da kuma shekarar 2019.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lekodišiša malwetši ao a fetetšego diphoofolo a 11 701 ao a ngwadilwego ka gare ga bobolokela bja tshedimošo bja bosetšhaba magareng ga 1993 le 2019.
Amharic: በ1993 እና 2019 መካከል በብሔራዊ ዳታቤዝ ውስጥ የተከማቹ 11 701 የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ ጉዳዮችን ገምግመዋል።

English: Then they analysed the data to find any patterns in how rabies spread over time and geographical space, and between animals.
Luganda: N’oluvannyuma beekaliriza obubaka okuzuula emiruko ku ngeri endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo gye yasaasaanamu okumala ekiseera n’ekitundu mwe yasaasaana, awamu n’ensaasaana yaayo mu nsolo.
Yoruba: Lẹ́yìn náà, wọ́n ṣe àtúpalẹ̀ àwọn dátà wọ̀nyí láti wo àwọn bátáàní tí àrun rébíìsì ṣe ń ràn kiri ní ìgbà dé ìgbà àti ní àwọn agbègbè kan, àti lahàárí àwọn ẹrànko.
Zulu: Base behlaziya idatha ukuze bathole noma imaphi amaphethini endleleni amarabi asakazeka ngayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi nendawo yendawo, naphakathi kwezilwane.
Hausa: Sannan nan kuma sun bincika bayanan don gano duk wani nau’i na yadda ciwon haukar yake yaɗuwa a tsawon lokaci da kuma sararin yanki, da kuma tsakanin dabbobi.
Northern Sotho: Go tloga fao ba ile ba sekaseka tshedimošo go hwetša mekgwa efe goba efe ya ka fao bogwasi bja dimpša bo phatlalalago ka gona ge nako e dutve e sepela le sekgobeng sa naga, le magareng ga diphoofolo.
Amharic: ከዚያም የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ በጊዜ እና በጂኦግራፊያዊ ቦታ፣ እና በእንስሳት መካከል፣ እንዴት እንደሚሰራጭ ለማወቅ መረጃውን ተንትነዋል።

English: They found that 60% of the cases reported were in domestic dogs, 21% in livestock, and 16% in wildlife.
Luganda: Baazuula ng’ebitundu 60% eby’ensaasaana yaayo byali mu mbwa ez’ewaka, ebitundu 21% mu nsolo ezirundibwa ewaka n’ebitundu 16% mu nsolo z’omu nsiko.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àwárí pé, ìdá 60% àwọn kéèsì tí a fi léde ni wọ́n ti ara àwọn ajá ilé wá, tí ìdá 21% sì wá láti ara ohun ọ̀sìn àti ìdá 16% láti ara àwọn ẹranko igbó.
Zulu: Bathola ukuthi u-60% wezigameko ezibikiwe ezezinja ezifuywayo, u-21% emfuyo, kanye no-16% ezilwaneni zasendle.
Hausa: Sun gano cewa kashi 60% na lokuta da aka ruwaito sun kasance a cikin karnuka na gida, kashi 21% a cikin dabbobi, da kuma kashi 16% a cikin namun daji.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gore 60% ya malwetši ao a begilwego a bile go dimpša tša ka gae, 21% ya diruiwa, le 16% ya diphoofolo tša naga.
Amharic: ሪፖርት ከተደረጉት ጉዳዮች ውስጥ 60%ው የቤት ውሾች፣ 21%ው በከብት፣ እና 16%ው በዱር አራዊት ውስጥ መሆናቸውን አረጋግጠዋል።

English: Interestingly, the wild animal that most commonly had rabies was the yellow mongoose.
Luganda: Ekisesa kiri nti, ensolo y’omu nsiko eyasinga okuba n’endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo kaali kakolwa.
Yoruba: Ó ṣe ni ní kàyéfì pé àwọn ẹranko igbó tí wọ́n ṣábà máa ń ní rébíìsì ni yellow mongoose.
Zulu: Ngokuthakazelisayo, isilwane sasendle esasivame ukuba namarabi kwakuyi-mongoose ephuzi.
Hausa: Abin sha’awa shi ne, dabbar daji da ta fi fama da ciwon haukar ita ce mongoose launin rawaya.
Northern Sotho: Seo se makatšago ke gore, phoofolo ya naga yeo e bego e fetelwa kudu ke bogaswi bja dimpša e be e le tola ye serolane.
Amharic: የሚገርመው፣ አብዛኛውን ጊዜ የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ ያለበት የዱር አራዊት ቢጫ ፍልፈል ነው።

English: They also found that wild animals were the main way that rabies spread between groups of wild and domestic animals.
Luganda: Mu ngeri endala era baazuula ng’ensolo z’omu nsiko y’engeri enkulu endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo mwe yayitanga okusaasaana mu bibinja by’ensolo z’omu nsiko n’ensolo ezirundibwa ewaka.
Yoruba: Wọn tún ríi mọ̀ pé àwọn ẹrànko igbó gangan ni olórí okùnfà ìrànkiri rébíìsì láàárín ọ̀wọ́ àwọn ẹrànko igbó àti ẹranko ilé.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola ukuthi izilwane zasendle zaziyiyona ndlela eyinhloko amarabi asakazeka ngayo phakathi kwamaqembu ezilwane zasendle nezasekhaya.
Hausa: Har ila yau, sun kuma gano cewa namun daji su ne babbar hanyar da ciwon haukar yake yaɗuwa a tsakanin rukunoni na dabbobin daji da na gida.
Northern Sotho: Ba utollotše gape gore diphoofolo tša naga e be e le tšona kudu tšeo bogaswi bja dimpša bo bego bo phatlalala magareng ga dihlopha tše tša diphoofolo tša naga le tša ka gae.
Amharic: የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ በዱር እና በቤት እንስሳት መካከል የሚስፋፋበት ዋነኛ መንገድ የዱር አራዊት መሆናቸውንም አረጋግጠዋል።

English: The KwaZulu-Natal province had 44% of all rabies cases because of the many dogs in the area.
Luganda: Ekitundu kya Kwa-Zulu Natal kyalina ebitundu 44% eby’abantu/ensolo ezirina endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo olw’embwa ennyingi eziri mu kitundu.
Yoruba: Agbègbè KwaZulu-Natal ní ìdá 44% gbogbo kéèsì rébíìsì nítorí pe ajá wọ́pọ̀ ní agbègbè náà.
Zulu: Isifundazwe saKwaZulu-Natali sinamaphesenti angama-44 azo zonke izifo zamarabi ngenxa yezinja eziningi endaweni.
Hausa: Lardin KwaZulu-Natal yana da kashi 44% na duk masu fama da ciwon haukar saboda yawan karnukan da suke yankin.
Northern Sotho: Phrobentshe ya KwaZulu-Natal e bile le 44% ya malwetši ka moka a bogaswi bja dimpša ka gobane go na le dimpša tše ntši ka lefelong leo.
Amharic: የኩዋዙሉ-ናታል ግዛት ከሁሉም የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ ተጠቂዎች 44%ቱ ነበሩት ምክንያቱም በአካባቢው ብዙ ውሾች ስላሉ።

English: On the other hand, the Freestate province had the highest wildlife cases.
Luganda: Ku ludda olulala, ekitundu kya Freestate kye kyalina omuwendo omunene ogw’endwadde eno ng’eva ku kulumwa ensolo z’omu nsiko.
Yoruba: Ní ọ̀nà mìíràn, agbègbèFreestate ni ó ní kéèsì ẹranko ìgbẹ́ tí ó pọ̀ jùlọ.
Zulu: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, isifundazwe saseFreestate sasinezilwane zasendle eziphakeme kakhulu.
Hausa: A hannu guda kuma, lardin Freestate yana da mafi girman namun daji mabambanta.
Northern Sotho: Ka go le lengwe, phrobentshe ya Foreisetata e bile le malwetši a mantši a diphoofolo.
Amharic: በሌላ በኩል፣ የፍሪስቴት ግዛት ከፍተኛው የዱር አራዊት ጉዳዮች ነበሩት።

English: Even so, rabies commonly spread across provincial borders.
Luganda: Wadde kiri kityo, endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo yateranga okusaasaana okusukka ensalo z’ebitundu mw’esibuse.
Yoruba: Bí ó tilẹ̀ wá rí bẹ́ẹ̀, àrùn rébíìsì a máa ran kiri láti ààlà agbègbè kan sí òmíràn.
Zulu: Noma kunjalo, amarabi avamise ukusabalala emingceleni yezifundazwe.
Hausa: Duk da haka, ciwon haukar yawanci yana yaɗuwa a kan iyakokin larduna.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, bogaswi bja dimpša bo phatlalala go ralala le mellwane ya phrobentshe ye.
Amharic: እንደዚያም ሆኖ፣ የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ አብዛኛውን ጊዜ በግዛት ድንበሮች ይተላለፋል።

English: Previous studies focused on learning how rabies infects individuals rather than looking at how it moves and spreads through and between groups over time and space.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza okwakolebwa mu biseera eby’emabega essira kwalissa ku kuyiga engeri endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo gy’ekwatamu abantu okusinga okutunuulira engeri endwadde eno gy’etambulamu era n’esaasaana mu bibinja eby’enjawulo mu kiseera n’ebitundu eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: Àwọn iṣẹ́ ìwádìí tí ó ti kọjá gbájúmọ́ kíkọ́ ẹ̀kọ́ lóríi bí rébíììsì ṣe ń ràn mọ́ ọlọ́danni, ju wíwá ọ̀na tí ó ń gbà ràn kiri láti ara ọ̀wọ́ kan sí òmíràn, ní àsìkò àti gbèdéke kan.
Zulu: Ucwaningo lwangaphambilini belugxile ekufundeni ukuthi amarabi abathelela kanjani abantu kunokubheka ukuthi ahamba kanjani futhi asakazeka kanjani phakathi namaqembu ngokuhamba kwesikhathi nendawo.
Hausa: Binciken da aka yi a baya sun mayar da hankali ne a kan koyon yadda ciwon haukar yake cutar da mutane maimakon kallon yadda yake motsawa da yaɗuwa ta hanyar da kuma tsakanin rukunoni a tsawon lokaci da kuma sarari.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di fetilego di ile tša nepiša kudu mabapi le go ithuta ka fao bogaswi bja dimpša bo fetelago batho sebakeng sa go lebelela ka fao go sepelago le go phatlalala le magareng ga dihlopha mo nakong ye itšego le lefelong.
Amharic: ቀደም ሲል የተደረጉ ጥናቶች የእብድ ውሻ በሽታ በግለሰቦች ላይ እንዴት እንደሚንቀሳቀስ እና በጊዜ እና በቦታ ላይ በቡድኖች መካከል እንዴት እንደሚንቀሳቀስ ከመመልከት ይልቅ ግለሰቦችን እንዴት እንደሚጎዳ በመወቅ ላይ ያተኮሩ ነበሩ።

English: These researchers say that one of the best ways to fight rabies in South Africa is through repeated vaccination campaigns, especially among dogs in KZN.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bano bagamba nti emu ku ngeri esingako ey’okulwanyisa endwadde eva ku kulumwa ensolo mu South Africa kwe kuddiŋŋananga enteekateeka ez’okugema, naddala mu mbwa mu KZN.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí sọ pé ọ̀nàkan pàtàkì láti gbógun tí rébíìsì ní South Afria ni nípasẹ gbígba abẹ́rẹ́ àjẹsára léraléra, pàápàá láàárin àwọn ajá ní KZN.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi bathi enye yezindlela ezingcono kakhulu zokulwa namarabi INingizimu Afrika inemikhankaso yokugoma ephindaphindiwe, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwezinja e-KZN.
Hausa: Waɗannan masu bincike sun ce ɗaya daga cikin mafi kyawun hanyoyin da za a yi yaki da ciwon haukar a Afirka ta Kudu ita ce ta hanyar yin kamfe na rigakafi akai-akai, musamman a tsakanin karnuka a KZN.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bolela gore ye nngwe ya ditsela tše kaone tša go lwantšha bogaswi bja dimpša ka Afrika Borwa ke ka masilo a meento ao a bušeletšwago, kudukudu magareng ga dimpša tša ka KZN.
Amharic: እነዚህ ተመራማሪዎች በደቡብ አፍሪካ ውስጥ የእብድ ውሻ በሽታን ለመከላከል ከሚረዱት ምርጥ መንገዶች አንዱ ተደጋጋሚ የክትባት ዘመቻዎች፣ በተለይም በ KZN ውስጥ ባሉ ውሾች ላይ ነው ይላሉ።

English: The South African researchers focused on their home country, but their findings may be useful for other parts of Africa where similar animals are found.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza b’omu South Africa essira baalissa ku ggwanga lyabwe ery’obuzaaliranwa, naye bye baazuula biyinza okuba eby’omugaso eri ebitundu ebirala ebisangibwa mu Afirika omuli ensolo zeezimu.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí South Africa gbájúmọ orílẹ̀ èdè wọn, ṣùgbọ́n àbọ̀ ìwádìí wọn ṣe é lo fún àwọn ilé Africa yókù tí wọ́n bá ti rí irúfẹ́ àwọn ẹrànko kan náà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baseNingizimu Afrika bagxile ngezwe labo, kodwa abakutholile kungase kube usizo kwezinye izingxenye ze-Afrika lapho kutholakala khona izilwane ezifanayo.
Hausa: Masu binciken na Afirka ta Kudu sun mayar da hankali ne a kan ƙasarsu, amma binciken nasu yana iya zama da amfani ga sauran sassan Afirka da ake samun dabbobi iri ɗaya.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba Afrika Borwa ba ile ba nepiša ka nageng ya gabobona, eupša dikutollo tša bona di ka ba mohola go dikarolo tše dingwe tša Afrika fao diphoofolo tša go swana le tše di hwetšagalago gona.
Amharic: የደቡብ አፍሪካ ተመራማሪዎች ትኩረታቸው በትውልድ አገራቸው ላይ ነበር፣ ነገር ግን ግኝቶቻቸው ተመሳሳይ እንስሳት ለሚገኙባቸው ሌሎች የአፍሪካ ክፍሎችም ጠቃሚ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ።
